en: Monochrome postcard view of a long, ornate classical building with many windows and a high, steep roof. The façade features decorative sculptural elements above the central entrance. The street in front is lined with large trees on the left and a few pedestrians in the distance. At the top of the card is a printed caption in German identifying the place as a lazaret (military hospital) named Turenne in the town of Sedan.
